summary: The variable directory provides mechanisms for translating and resolving date and parameter placeholders, defining supported variable types and date parameter keywords.
responsibilities: Defines supported variable types and date parameter keywords.
Resolves and translates date and parameter placeholders.
relationships: VariableTranslatorImpl resolves date and parameter placeholders using VariableType, VariableDateParameter, and VARIABLE_DATE_PARAMETERS.
design_decisions: Uses an enumeration and type alias to define supported variable types and date parameter keywords.
Provides an implementation class for resolving date and parameter placeholders.
